name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router: Server Components, streaming, routing, data fetching, caching, SSR/SSG, and full-stack features.

Use for new apps, Pages Router migrations, Server Components, streaming, parallel/intercepting routes, caching, and Server Actions.

Modes: Server Components (data/secrets/heavy work); Client Components (interactivity/hooks/browser APIs); Static (build time); Dynamic (request time); Streaming (progressive UI).

Conventions: `layout.tsx` shared UI; `page.tsx` route; `loading.tsx` Suspense UI; `error.tsx` boundary; `not-found.tsx` 404; `route.ts` API; `template.tsx` remounted layout; `default.tsx` parallel-route fallback; `opengraph-image.tsx` OG image.

Patterns:
- Root layout: `next/font/google`, metadata, providers, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`.
- Server pages fetch data directly; use `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>` and `params: Promise<{ id: string }>` (await them).
- Colocate data fetching; check `res.ok`; use `Suspense` fallbacks for slow independent content.
- Client interactivity: `'use client'`, hooks, `useTransition`; mutations via Server Actions.
- Server Actions may use `cookies` from `next/headers`, `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath` from `next/cache`, and `redirect` from `next/navigation`.
- Parallel routes use named slots (`analytics`, `team`) and `default.tsx`; intercepting photo routes can render modals alongside full-page routes.
- Route handlers use `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; support GET/POST, parse `request.nextUrl.searchParams` or `request.json()`, return JSON/status codes.
- Dynamic metadata: `generateMetadata`; static paths: `generateStaticParams`; use `notFound()` for missing content.
- Fetch caching: `cache: "no-store"` (fresh), `cache: "force-cache"` (static), `next: { revalidate: 60 }` (ISR), `next: { tags: ["products"] }` (tag invalidation).

Paths:
`app/layout.tsx`
`app/page.tsx`
`app/products/page.tsx`
`components/products/ProductList.tsx`
`components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`
`app/actions/cart.ts`
`app/dashboard/layout.tsx`
`app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`
`app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx`
`app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`
`(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx`
`[id]/page.tsx`
`app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx`
`app/photos/[id]/page.tsx`
`app/layout.tsx`
`app/product/[id]/page.tsx`
`app/api/products/route.ts`
`app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`
`app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`

**Start with Server Components** - Add 'use client' only when needed
**Colocate data fetching** - Fetch data where it's used
**Use Suspense boundaries** - Enable streaming for slow data
**Leverage parallel routes** - Independent loading states
**Use Server Actions** - For mutations with progressive enhancement
**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
